```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Read in Seurat object of all cells
# Subset out non-haematopoietic clusters
# Normalise, scale data, QC, assign clusters, find markers and save object.

#Load libraries
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)

#load Seurat object of all cells
load("Seurat_object/samples_merged.Robj")

#Subset out non-haematopoietic clusters - "27" = Chondrocytes, "28" = Osteoblast lineage cells, "31" = Endothelial cells, "32" = VSMCs (identified from manual annotation using canonical markers and markers identified from FindAllMarkers function)
non_haematopoietic <- subset(samples_merged, ident.use = c("27", "28", "31", "32"))

#Normalise data
non_haematopoietic <- NormalizeData(non_haematopoietic, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

#Find variable features
non_haematopoietic <- FindVariableGenes(object = non_haematopoietic, mean.function = ExpMean, dispersion.function = LogVMR,
                           x.low.cutoff = 0.0125, x.high.cutoff = 3, y.cutoff = 0.5)
#Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(non_haematopoietic)
non_haematopoietic <- ScaleData(non_haematopoietic, features = all.genes)

#Linear dimensional reduction
non_haematopoietic <- RunPCA(non_haematopoietic, features = VariableFeatures(object = non_haematopoietic))

#Clustering and UMAP
non_haematopoietic <- FindClusters(object = non_haematopoietic, reduction.type = "pca", dims.use = 1:20,
                                          resolution = 1.2, print.output = 0, save.SNN = TRUE)

non_haematopoietic <- RunUMAP(non_haematopoietic, dims = 1:20)

pdf("plots/umap_non_haematopietic_resolution_1.2.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
DimPlot(non_haematopoietic, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.1.2", pt.size = 0.01, label = T, raster = F)
dev.off()

#Findallmarkers
non_haematopoietic_markers <- FindAllMarkers(object = non_haematopoietic, logfc.threshold = 0.5, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)

#Subset out unwanted cells (neuronal cells and doublets based on manual annotation and markers identified from the FindAllMarkers function above) and recluster. 

non_haematopoietic_clean <- subset(non_haematopoietic, ident.use = c("3", "12", "5", "1", "9", "15", "14", "4", "0", "2", "11", "10", "13"))

#Normalise data
non_haematopoietic_clean <- NormalizeData(non_haematopoietic_clean, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

#Find variable features
non_haematopoietic_clean <- FindVariableGenes(object = non_haematopoietic_clean, mean.function = ExpMean, dispersion.function = LogVMR,
                           x.low.cutoff = 0.0125, x.high.cutoff = 3, y.cutoff = 0.5)
#Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(non_haematopoietic_clean)
non_haematopoietic_clean <- ScaleData(non_haematopoietic_clean, features = all.genes)

#Linear dimensional reduction
non_haematopoietic_clean <- RunPCA(non_haematopoietic_clean, features = VariableFeatures(object = non_haematopoietic_clean))

#Clustering and UMAP
non_haematopoietic_clean <- FindClusters(object = non_haematopoietic_clean, reduction.type = "pca", dims.use = 1:20,
                                          resolution = 1.2, print.output = 0, save.SNN = TRUE)

non_haematopoietic_clean <- RunUMAP(non_haematopoietic_clean, dims = 1:20)

pdf("plots/umap_non_haematopietic_resolution_1.2.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
DimPlot(non_haematopoietic_clean, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.1.2", pt.size = 0.01, label = T, raster = F)
dev.off()

#Findallmarkers
non_haematopoietic_clean_markers <- FindAllMarkers(object = non_haematopoietic_clean, logfc.threshold = 0.5, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)

#save object
save(non_haematopoietic_clean, file = "Seurat_object/non_haematopoietic_clean.Robj")


```
